description: This file contains ViewModel classes for managing notes in an Android application, including operations such as loading, inserting, updating, deleting, and searching notes.

classes.name: NoteViewModel
classes.description: Shared ViewModel for handling list of notes and search functionality.

classes.name: SingleNoteViewModel
classes.description: ViewModel for managing a single note's data, including load, insert, update, and delete operations.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Sets the search query to filter notes.

methods.name: loadNote
methods.description: Loads a note by its ID asynchronously.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new note asynchronously and executes a callback with the inserted note's ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing note asynchronously and executes a callback after completion.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a note asynchronously and executes a callback after completion.
